tldr: Tennessee's governor has suspended executions after a death row inmate survived two lethal injection attempts.
A new four-person crew successfully launched to the International Space Station, including the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit.
The 30-year fixed mortgage rate jumped significantly to 7.28%, marking its biggest weekly increase in four years.

market.why: The Nasdaq Composite experienced a modest gain, potentially supported by strong individual company performances like Accenture's significant earnings beat. In contrast, the S&P 500 saw a slight decline, amidst a broader environment where investors were engaged in selling government debt.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased slightly, driven by continued selling of government debt by investors.

vix.why: The articles do not provide a direct explanation for the slight increase in the VIX.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 42% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as reported by Freddie Mac's weekly survey, increased by 0.25% to 7.28%. This surge aligns with the recent upward trend in the 10-year Treasury yield, which mortgage rates typically track.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Temporary regulations establish general requirements for Trump accounts, including automatic enrollment by the Secretary of the Treasury.
policy_week.effect: You have automatic enrollment in a Trump account.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance for employer contributions to Trump accounts.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to a Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on eligible investments for Trump accounts.
policy_week.effect: You would have an obligation to only invest Trump account funds in eligible investments.

policy_week.what_happened: This document announces the fee that HUD will collect from borrowers of loans guaranteed under HUD's Section 108 Loan Guarantee Program.
policy_week.effect: If you use a Section 108 Loan Guarantee Program, your fee to offset credit subsidy costs changes from 0.58 percent.

tech.summary: A federal judge has dismissed antitrust lawsuits against Google regarding its AI-powered search features, specifically AI Overviews, ruling in favor of Google against claims of driving away web traffic.

Sony is introducing new AI upscaling technology, Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), for the regular PlayStation 5, which aims to enhance graphics performance as a result of its Project Amethyst collaboration with AMD.

Artificial intelligence has achieved a significant milestone by defeating the best human Stratego player, a feat accomplished by incorporating a second neural network designed to identify hidden pieces.

world.summary: Russia has launched extensive strikes on Ukraine's energy grid, resulting in power cuts in Kyiv and other regions and killing seven people, ahead of the winter season.

Britain is engaged in discussions with European allies regarding the potential release of emergency diesel stockpiles, following a threat from the Trump administration to cut off US supplies of the fuel.
Chinese hackers reportedly impersonated AI experts, including a former White House AI official, in an effort to target US policy minds with deceptive tactics.

us.summary: Tennessee's governor has suspended all executions for a year and ordered an independent inquiry after a death row inmate survived two lethal injection attempts, described as "deeply disturbing."

A new crew of four astronauts, including two NASA astronauts, one Canadian, and a Russian cosmonaut, successfully launched from Florida aboard a SpaceX Crew Dragon capsule en route to the International Space Station.

New York City's "click-to-cancel" subscription rule has taken effect, mandating that businesses make it as straightforward to cancel a subscription as it is to sign up, aligning with similar laws in other jurisdictions.

science.summary: A four-person crew, featuring Jessica Watkins, the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit, successfully launched to the International Space Station, marking her second journey to the orbital outpost.

A new £2.3 million study will investigate whether a personalized pain management plan can significantly improve the quality of life for millions of women who suffer from the debilitating condition of endometriosis.
